# generateapikey

> Zero-dependency library for secure API keys and MFA, published for Python (PyPI: `generateapikey`) and JavaScript/TypeScript (npm: `@nuhmanpk/generateapikey`) with the same version number. Keys, storage hashing, scopes, rotation, framework auth, TOTP/HOTP, recovery codes, one-time codes, magic links, JWT (HS/RS/PS/ES/EdDSA) and AES-GCM secrets at rest. Both packages share one wire format, so values made in one language verify in the other.

Install: `pip install generateapikey` (import `generateapikey`) or `npm i @nuhmanpk/generateapikey`. With a package installed, `generate-api-key --llms` (Python) or `npx @nuhmanpk/generateapikey --llms` (JS) prints the guide for that exact version.
